props.name: points
props.description: Tens of thousands is fine: points are counted, not drawn.

props.name: radius
props.description: Controlled hexagon radius, in viewBox pixels.

props.name: showRadiusControl
props.description: Show the radius slider above the chart.

props.name: colorScale
props.description: How counts map to colour. Square root and log keep a few dense bins from washing out the rest.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Name of the horizontal measure, printed under the axis.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Name of the vertical measure, printed beside the axis.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Format x values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: formatY
props.description: Format y values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width fills the container.
